messages:
Maya: FYI Atlasica just hit a big embed ramp overnight, looks like their committed creditline will run out earlier than our forecast. tagging for runway calc and QBR prep.
Owen: pulling the usage windows now — noticed a 3x bump in embed calls between 02:00–06:00 UTC.
Maya: ouch. do we have a projected runout date?
Owen: quick calc: current balance 120k credits, avg burn 11k/day (last 7d) but recent surge pushes effective burn to ~22k/day. projection -> 5–6 days at current rate.
Ravi: timeline is tight. can we do short-term throttle on non-prod keys and prioritize prod traffic? Also we should prep a recommended top-up amount for sales.
Jules: Atlasica is asking for a temporary uplift to avoid demo disruptions next week. they said they can approve a 30% top-up if we give concrete mitigation plan.
Maya: action list for QBR: 1) runout date + burn drivers 2) proposed short-term fixes (throttle/non-prod hold/kv caching) 3) top-up ask and value props 4) follow-up enablement session.
Owen: dumping the quick numbers here:
```
window, avg/day, recent/day
7d, 11k, 22k
30d, 9k, 18k
projection (no change): 5 days
```
Ravi: I can schedule a 30-min enablement with their infra team tomorrow to review prefix caching and request routing. Recommend we enable KV caching and switch heavy-reporting jobs to off-peak.
Maya: costbot just flagged an alert — see below.
costbot: ALERT: account/atlasica embed burn 210% above baseline (since 1711100000). Threshold breached -> notify cs oncall.
Jules: Sales wants a clear asks table for their approval thread. Maya can you propose the exact top-up amount and suggested SLA?
Maya: propose 150k credits upfront (covers ~7 days at surge) + a 90k reserve for 2-week glide. also propose temporary soft-throttle for non-prod.
Owen: I'll update the spreadsheet and push a short table into the QBR deck. putting a row for estimated unit economics delta if top-up accepted.
Ravi: I'll run a quick config checklist for enablement and send a runbook snippet:
```
- enable_kv_cache: true
- reduce_report_freq: 60m -> 6h
- nonprod_keys: set_quota(10% of prod)
```
Maya: ok assigning tasks: Owen (numbers + deck row), Ravi (runbook + enablement call), Jules (get sign-off from account), Maya (top-up ask + renewal note). Reply with thumbs when you got it.
Owen: got it :thumbsup:
Ravi: on it :white_check_mark:
Jules: pinging account now, will update in thread.
Maya: wrapping: include these three slides in the QBR: spend variance, mitigation timeline, ask/impact. we should be able to present a recommended motion in the next customer sync.
Jules: noted — will escalate if account pushes back.
Maya: thanks team — will capture feedback from enablement call and fold into renewal risk section.
